Hello everyone,

I started using shiny app just recently and have some basic questions. Any assistance is greatly appreciated. 

Scenario: I have some queries that run on a database and would like to automate them so that users can request them on shiny app and it runs in the background and sends them an email with output and also highlights the updates on the main panel of which stage the process is:

####Code##########

ui.R

notes: 

[I have included the necessary inputs below in ui.R and am looking for a HTML outlined box which provides updates while the process is running and gives me the output (at1.R) once its completed.

Updates like "Process started" - "First step completed" and so on]


##start

library(shiny)

# Define UI for application that draws a histogram
shinyUI(fluidPage(
  
  wellPanel(fluidRow(
    column(3,h1("")),column(6,h2("Title")),column(3,h1(""))
  )),

    , mainPanel(

)


Server.R


library(shiny)
source('at1.R')

# Define server logic required to draw a histogram
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  

    output$output <- renderText({
      
      
      result = func(user_name = input$Username,num1 = input$num1, num2 = input$num2, date1 = input$dates[1], date2 = input$dates[2], ind1 = input$ind1)
      
      paste0(result)
      
    })
    

})

at1.R

Questions:
  • I am running the code below but am not seeing that the necessary sql is not getting executed from the function (at1.R) - How do i know what exactly is shiny doing after i trigger the "submit" button
